A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe the same DiT4SR work and support direct comparison of methods, equations, experiments, figures, and tables. Neither contains appendices or embedded supplementary files. Both reference separate supplementary material that is unavailable, so judgments cover the supplied PDFs.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results on four datasets in Table 1, user-study outcomes in Table 2, and component ablations in Table 3.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, user-study, and ablation results in Tables 1–3, alongside qualitative restoration examples.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same architecture and procedure: LR integration into joint attention, LR residual connections, and zero-initialized 3×3 depth-wise convolution between the streams' MLPs.

E1.justification: The training mixture remains DIV2K, DIV8K, Flickr2K, FFHQ, and self-captured images. Evaluation still covers DrealSR, RealSR, RealLR200, and RealLQ250, with the same restoration task and examples.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains all ten comparators, including DreamClear and SD3-ControlNet. Table 2 retains SeeSR, DiffBIR, SUPIR, and DreamClear. The newly cited related methods are not added to any reported comparison.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains the degradation pipeline, ×4 scaling, image resolutions, center-cropping, dataset sample counts, and five evaluation metrics. The user study still involves 80 volunteers and 60 images, and the ablation training controls remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 3 and Figures 4, 5, and 7 retain the same attention-map analysis and tests of LR integration, LR residuals, removal of LR injection, and replacing convolution with a linear layer. No robustness or supplementary analysis is added.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. The reporting practice for benchmark scores and user-study percentages is unchanged.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–3 and the qualitative examples match. For example, DiT4SR's RealLQ250 MUSIQ/MANIQA remain 71.832/0.632, and its realism preference rate against SeeSR remains 82.1%. No numerical results, rankings, or reported findings change.

T1.justification: The token definitions, dimensions, joint Q/K/V construction in Equation 1, and attention calculation in Equation 2 are unchanged. Neither version adds formal assumptions, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about pioneering large-scale DiT adaptation, bidirectional LR interaction, local convolutional guidance, and restoration performance. Section 2 clarifies positioning without redefining these contributions.

C2.justification: Both versions give the same explanations of progressively refined LR guidance, residuals preserving guidance in deeper blocks, and convolution recovering local structure. The discussion of non-reference metrics inadequately reflecting fidelity improvements is also retained; no new limitations are stated.

D1.justification: The disclosed initialization, convolution dimensions, preprocessing, SD3-ControlNet configuration, and project-page link remain unchanged. Both defer further implementation details to separate supplementary material absent from the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds DiT-SR, FoundIR, TSD-SR, and One Diffusion Step to Real-World Super-Resolution via Flow Trajectory Distillation. It distinguishes training DiT-SR from scratch and concurrent one-step approaches, and explicitly emphasizes network architecture when positioning DiT4SR's novelty. The broader literature discussion remains intact.

P1.justification: Section 2 receives a short expansion and limited wording corrections. The author line changes Jimmy Ren to Jimmy S. Ren and adds a Hong Kong Metropolitan University affiliation. The section sequence and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–3 retain their content and structure. Added prose causes limited column and page reflow: Section 3.2 moves from page 4 to page 5, and the expanded bibliography extends into the right column of page 11.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves scholarly positioning by acknowledging DiT-SR and concurrent one-step approaches and clarifying the architectural focus of its novelty in Section 2. This addresses a limited omission in v1's related-work discussion. The scientific method, empirical support, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
